audit_scope: Full audit of 40 evaluated claims across 8 evaluated benchmark cases

bibliographic_footer.description: Non-clinical bibliographic source summaries parsed as claims.

genuine_citation_defect.description: Citations referencing page numbers exceeding approved PDF page bounds (e.g. AASLD p. 31, p. 25, p. 27; EASL-ERN p. 18).

truncated_evaluator_passage.description: Valid citation where evaluator received only a 150-char preview slice.

multiple_passages_not_aggregated.description: Multi-citation sentences evaluated without combining evidence.

unsupported_claim.description: Substantive claim unsupported after full passage inspection.

v1_supported_claims_breakdown.finding: Both v1 'supported' claims (WD-BENCH-007 #5, WD-BENCH-008 #5) were bibliographic footers accidentally matching citation headers.

corrected_evidence_metric.note: Because the original evaluation run (v1) supplied only 150-character passage previews in telemetry, the 28 non-defective clinical claims cannot be confirmed as supported without unabridged retrieved passage text. In accordance with strict evidence integrity, missing evidence is marked as unresolved rather than manufactured as supported.
